about-hero-desc: Internal platform for managing, validating and submitting OTC Derivatives trades to B3 — centralized, traceable and integrated into the operational workflow.
about-feat-ndf-desc: Import NDF trade files via Dropzone, with automatic validation, table view and submission to Conecta B3.
about-feat-opt-desc: Manage Commodities Options trades, with support for bulk import, message parsing and full B3 integration.
about-feat-index-desc: Register and maintain B3 reference indices used in the mapping and validation of Commodities trades.
about-feat-fwd-desc: Forward-start NDF trades, with import, Accronym column, client autofill, the Strike and Strike Set Offset columns from the API, and client confirmation generation.
about-feat-other-desc: NDF trades from other publishers, with Accronym column, auto-fill of Client/Tax ID and full maker-checker approval and submission flow.
about-feat-recon-desc: Comitente reconciliation across B3, CGD and Party Central, with per-field matching scores, automatic status and export (Excel, CSV, PDF).
about-feat-submit-desc: Automatic generation of submission files in the format required by B3 and dispatch to the Conecta system, with per-trade result tracking.
about-feat-mapping-desc: Link each trade's internal ID to the ID assigned by B3 after registration, ensuring end-to-end traceability.
about-feat-users-desc: Access control based on JPMorgan SID, 2FA authentication via email, new user approval workflow and role management.
about-feat-cp-desc: Hub for operational routines. The first routine saves the Daily Settlements CETIP files (Alteryx flow translated to Python), defaulting to the ANBIMA D-1 date.
about-feat-fcst-desc: Projection of settlements over the next 14 business days (ANBIMA), broken down by product and entity, with dashboard charts and an automatic email report to OTC Ops.
about-feat-refdata-desc: Counterparty editor (glass style) with bank accounts, contacts and CGD, maker-checker workflow, Default PAY/RECEIVE accounts and Premium/Economic Affirmation email (.eml) generation.
about-feat-intrag-desc: Generation and delivery of Intrag custody files for NDF and Options, with a Status column and lifecycle (New, Pending, Approved, Sent) under maker-checker approval.
about-feat-mtm-desc: Mark-to-Market of swaps by LOB (CEM, EDG, Hybrids) and COE: MtM value mapping, reconciliation against B3, end-of-month validation and generation of the Conecta files.
about-feat-accrual-desc: PU/Factor update of VCP swaps: generation of the update records, reconciliation against B3, maker-checker cycle and end-of-month (EOM) process with an e-mail to OTC Ops.
about-feat-pending-desc: Tracking of pending confirmations by aging bucket, with widgets per pending type (Digital Signature, FO, MO, POA, OTC…), a smart filter and export.
about-step1-desc: Drag or select trade files. The system automatically validates and filters duplicates and cancelled trades.
about-step2-desc: View, filter and edit imported trades in the interactive table before proceeding with submission.
about-step3-desc: Automatic generation of the Conecta file and submission to B3 with per-trade status tracking.
about-step4-desc: Link the B3 ID returned to the internal record, completing end-to-end traceability of the trade.
about-notif-desc: Automatic alerts for relevant events: new imported deals, status changes, Index B3 updates, bulk deletions, B3 submissions and mappings. ADMIN users also receive access request notifications.
about-auth-desc: SID-based access with verification via the internal JPMorgan phonebook. New users go through an approval flow with a 2FA code sent by corporate email. Roles and permissions managed by administrators.
about-cta-desc: Access the trade modules and manage your deals directly on the platform.
demo-text: This is the English version of the text used in this demo. It serves as the default language content before translation is applied. By setting up i18n support, this text can be easily switched to other languages, ensuring a more inclusive and accessible user experience.
cp-sec-ds-desc: Routines that process data sources and save the required files into the settlement folders.
cp-r-cetip-desc: Reads the raw CETIP files from the B3 daily download folder, renames them to the standard convention and saves them into the settlement folders used by the KPI.
cp-sec-fc-desc: Routines that consolidate positions and generate analytical reports sent by e-mail.
cp-r-fcst-desc: Reads the CETIP position files, projects the upcoming settlements by business day and entity, and e-mails the consolidated forecast report to OTC Ops.
cp-sec-rd-desc: Routines that update counterparty reference data from spreadsheets.
cp-r-contacts-desc: Imports the "CONTATO DE CLIENTES" spreadsheet and replaces each counterparty's contacts with the Active ones only (matched by SPN, leading zeros ignored). CGD and banking data are preserved.

about-feat-dsndf-desc: Aggregated NDF settlement cards (Summary) plus a per-counterparty Cockpit with an editable grid — import, add/edit/delete and confirm rows.
about-feat-dsswap-desc: Swap positions and settlements by engine — Athena and VCP totals, Swap Events and Kapital Hybrids — with per-column filtering and export.
about-feat-cognos-desc: Option settlement (Cognos) with an editable grid — import, add/edit/delete and confirm — and Call/Put/Total widgets.
about-feat-opsb3-desc: B3 operations files by operation type (JPM + MGT) with an editable grid — import, CRUD and confirm rows.
about-feat-lpndf-desc: Live NDF position with classification widgets (Vanilla, Commodities, T+0, Other Publisher) and per-column filtering.
about-feat-lpswap-desc: Swap book in custody: characteristics by contract type, cashflows (DFLUXO) and premiums (DAGENDAPREMIOS), with widgets, breadcrumbs and export.
about-feat-lpopt-desc: Live Option position with settlement/status widgets and per-column filtering.
about-feat-payrec-desc: Reconciles JPM/MGT payments and receipts against bank statements and SPB actuals, per counterparty net type, carrying forward unresolved rows and withholding the swap regressive tax so the internal gross side meets the net amount that actually left the account.
about-feat-reconfxo-desc: Matches the FX option position registered at B3 against the Athena EOD report, field by field — direction, type, counterparty, quantity, premium, strike, dates and the asian fixing schedule — keyed on DealID and, when it is absent, on MatchingDealID.
about-feat-fileint-desc: Parses e-mail messages (.msg / HTML) to extract structured trade data from Outlook exports.
about-feat-holidays-desc: Editable, persisted market-holiday calendar (ANBIMA and FX schedules) used across the app for business-day math.
about-feat-pageaccess-desc: Per-page and per-card access control (including Control Panel cards), with access cloning between users and role management.

cp-r-ds-desc: Processes ALL Daily Settlement files into JSONs — OTM cashflows, Operações JPM/MGT, Eventos Swap, TSS-FX, BR Onshore, Latam Desk (FbiRptLatamDeskPostion-NY-*). Drop files here, or leave empty to scan the Settlements folder. Each page can also process its own file individually.

about-feat-swapchar-desc: Snapshot of the swap book in custody by reference date (D-1 ANBIMA): widgets by Contract Type, LOB, Indexer and Feature, per-column filter and export, read from the DPOSICAO-SWAP position file.
about-feat-otm-desc: Imports the cashflows file (dropzone or folder), applies the macro cleaning (DELETE/codes) and writes the daily JSON. Widgets by Asset Class (Rates, Equities, Commodities) counting distinct Trade IDs, with per-column filter and export.
about-feat-opssum-desc: Settlement batch by date: count and value cards reconciling B3 against the internal side, a Trade Level with per-trade withholding tax and differences, the counterparty net (Receive/Pay/Settlement Net, account and observation) and the TED release e-mail — all read from the same derived rows, so card and table can never disagree.

TO = the counterparty's confirmation contacts; CC = that counterparty's bankers + Brazil OTC Ops + IS Trade Doc. Downloads a .zip of .eml drafts — nothing is sent automatically.

map-tab-ndfc-split: NDF Commodities Advice — Split by Commodity
about-feat-ndfvanilla-desc: Vanilla NDF trades (PTAX) with import, validation, mass edit and the same approval and Conecta submission cycle as the other New Deals pages.
about-feat-ndmonitor-desc: Product × status view of the trades imported on the date, with day-by-day history and the automatic pending-items e-mail at 19:00 and 19:30 (Brazil time).
about-feat-conf-desc: Confirmation document per counterparty × asset — Word, PDF and XML written to the Electronic Inventory — with an editing panel, a New → Generated → Success cycle and a validation checklist. Covers NDF Commodities, Commodity Options, FX Options and forward-start currency forwards.
about-feat-swadv-desc: Swap settlement notice per counterparty: both legs' indexes, term, withholding tax from the regressive table and the net result, with PDF printing and a New → Generated → Sent status shared with the Settlement Summary.
about-feat-ndfadv-desc: Commodity forward settlement notice: underlying asset, PTAX and the fixing-date quote, the 0.005% withholding tax driven by an exemption register, and notice splitting by net type and — where registered — per commodity.
about-feat-msg-desc: Bilateral settlement messages built from Operations B3, one per type × counterparty, checked against the internal amount (“Favor considerar”), with swap maturities grouped into a single notice.
about-feat-lpcash-desc: Cashflows of the swap book in custody (DFLUXO), with per-column filtering and export.
about-feat-lpprem-desc: Swap premium schedule (DAGENDAPREMIOS), the internal source used to check the premium notices.
about-feat-ei-desc: Per-counterparty document tree on the team share: manual upload, year/month/day navigation and the automatic destination of every generated confirmation.
about-feat-tickets-desc: Internal tickets with sequential numbering (#OTC-0001), attachments, comments and per-role permissions — who opens, who handles and who can see.
about-feat-metrics-desc: Pending-confirmation indicators by ageing bucket and by type, for management follow-up.
about-step5-desc: Per-counterparty document — Word, PDF and XML — validated by checklist and filed.
about-step6-desc: Client notices, TED release and reconciliation of what actually left the account.

cp-r-pcx-desc: Saves the "PENDING - Outstanding Confirmation OTC.xlsx" spreadsheet to the Movimento share, overwriting the previous file — the Pending rows of the Pending Confirmation page, in the historical spreadsheet layout, with date columns as real dates (dd/mm/yyyy). Runs automatically every ANBIMA business day at 10:45 Brasília (7:15 PM IST); Run saves it now.
